answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Mercer bolt standard lodged with the mercers guild — 1-year apprenticeship, 188 supervised bolts, guild exam, 57 POA annual fee, renewal. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 779 fakes need 779, at 92 POA each, totalling 71668 POA. The velvet is the door, the nebula is the toll, and the lagoon is the toll-keeper's book, open to anyone. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
